_comment: Curated excerpt anchors for the knowledge base. Each entry names a PDF page and the first/last words of a passage. scripts/data/extract-kb.ts pulls the EXACT text from the downloaded PDF between those anchors (nothing is retyped) and fails if an anchor is missing. Selection was proposed by SAMVAAD's developer assistant; every excerpt starts as pending_review and is only usable after a human curator approves it.
